title: German wholesale price index, monthly observations 1920–June 1924
source: Statistisches Reichsamt, reproduced by Young (1925) and Sargent (1982)
license: Sargent (1982), in R. E. Hall (ed.), Inflation: Causes and Effects (NBER, 1982): '© 1982 by The National Bureau of Economic Research. All rights reserved.' The series is a factual transcription of official German statistics (Statistisches Reichsamt, through Young 1925), with full credit to Sargent, the volume and the NBER.
notes: Sargent Table G1 pp.74–75. Stop at June 1924 to avoid the unadjusted unit break in July. Original official statistical series, obtained here through Sargent/Young, not an independent second series. The table does not specify observation day; no daily peak inflation inferred. Adjacent monthly-index ratios and uniform 30-day equivalent doubling times are calculations, not day-level observations. The copy read is listed under documents (with its SHA-256); the rows hold no quotations, so data/fetch/verify_web_quotes.py does not read this snapshot.
